fieldNotes.truckGate: Definitive - Street View (2024-05) shows a 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' sign, a stop sign, a 'SPEED LIMIT 10' sign and a controlled driveway leaving Old Georgia Hwy into the fenced plant property.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Definitive - a guard booth with a canopy over the truck lane, with traffic cones and check-in equipment beside it, sits at the truck entrance (clear in Street View 2024-05).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Truck driveway from Old Georgia Hwy through the guard gate runs a long distance into the property before reaching the docks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yard on the SW holds ~12-18 trailers in two rows (z20 imagery).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and large open paved yard provide room for a bypass/express lane around the single booth.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~28 estimated; dock bays read along the south building face with trailers backed in - partly obscured, low-confidence count.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur runs along the SE edge of the property and serves a silo-equipped industrial building (bulk ingredient receiving) associated with the plant.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant building plus a separate rail-served silo/ingredient building on the SE.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Gaffney SC is a small town; the plant sits on the edge of town along a highway with farmland and woods around it - rural.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly confirmed; an elongated marked strip in the truck yard is more likely a parking median - flagged uncertain.
